full_judgment: 13. So from the above, it cannot be said that mere listing the case property in 'Ka' list, the possession of which, according to the petitioner, is him, do not make any difference as regard the character of the case land as an abandoned property. The petitioner also could not rebut the said presumption by adducing any evidence before the Court of Settlement which is clear from the finding of the Court below, inter alia that the domicile certificate, non-option certificate; citizenship certificate and reliable evidence of nationality of Bangladesh of the original allottee, who is an immigrant are not forthcoming in the records. The petitioner Could not show or there is no material to show that the possession of the said land has not been taken pursuant to notice to surrender dated 8.2.86 prior to publication in the official Gazette dated 23.9.86.
